summary: The union is the disjoint union of |s| translates of J, each of measure μ(J).

steps.claim: s is finite (its cardinality is non-zero); view it as a finset.
steps.lean: lift s to Finset (H ⧸ J) using finite_of_ncard_ne_zero f

steps.claim: The preimage of s is the disjoint union of the cosets t ∈ s, and each coset tJ = t·J has measure μ(J) by left invariance; so the measure is |s|·μ(J).
steps.lean:
rw [← sum_measure_preimage_singleton, Finset.sum_eq_card_nsmul (b := μ J)] <;>
    simp [forall_mk, preimage, eq_class_eq_leftCoset, h.const_smul, -measurableSet_setOfPred]
